messages.message: hi my phone is barely working and im so annoyed 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Daniel. How can I help you today?
my screen is flickering and i cant even use the apps. its so frustrating
I am sorry to hear that you're having such a frustrating experience with your device, I can definitely help you look into this.
i just want it fixed now. im Fatima Iyer and my number is 97299 03137
Thanks Fatima. Let me check the system. It looks like you have the latest model, right?
yeah its the pro model. i tried restarting it but it didnt work
Got it. Since the restart didn't work, it sounds like a hardware issue with the display.
so what do we do? i cant keep using it like this
I can arrange for a replacement device to be sent to your home address so you can swap it out.
oh wow really? that would be great! thank you so much
You're very welcome! I've processed that request now.
thanks daniel you've been a huge help 😊
Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I'll get that replacement device shipped out immediately. Have a great day!
